summary: Equifax Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $1.0 billion aggregate senior notes in two tranches: $500 million 5.000% notes due 2029 and $500 million 5.650% notes due 2033. The notes were sold under an underwriting agreement with J.P. Morgan, BofA Securities, Truist, and Wells Fargo, issued under a base indenture with U.S. Bank Trust as trustee. Interest is semi-annual, with make-whole redemption provisions. This is an ordinary debt financing, not a special situation. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is present.
